title: Tavern 0.6.207: loaded-clock item pickup delay
public_notes_inline: Overflow and Tomb Raider item pickup delays now count loaded script ticks like Java's setPickUpDelay, instead of world absolute time which freezes with dodaylightcycle off. Deadlines persist under the same dynamic-property keys with a script: prefix; legacy numeric values keep their original per-producer clock semantics, and restored item handles resume the previous countdown instead of restarting it. Pickup/drink, living-mob Tomb and effect-clock regressions pass; no client or Native wire result is claimed.
